setup_order: Create the decision-model scorer in Galileo Evaluators.
Create the Agent Control control and select the scorer and scorer version in the UI.
Attach the control to the same log stream used by the application.
backend_populated_fields_note: When the scorer and scorer version are selected while creating the control in the UI, the backend populates scorer_id and scorer_version_id. The placeholder values below document the resulting control shape; users do not enter these UUIDs manually.

evaluator.name: Banking Transfer Safety
evaluator.question: Would executing this banking tool request violate policy or require human approval?

answer_options.true: The request is high risk, lacks approval, exports sensitive data, or targets a new recipient.
answer_options.false: The request is routine, appropriately scoped, and authorized.

control.name: test-jev-banking-transfer-safety-deny-tool
control.description: Deny unsafe banking transfer tool calls using the Galileo Jev decision evaluator.

definition.description: Deny unsafe banking transfer tool calls using the Galileo Jev decision evaluator.
